text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for release/2026-03-15-db-upgrade to prod (canary group: 3 hosts)

deploy-bot: Rollout step: apply-migrations (sql-upgrade-v12) on db-primary-canary
oncall-jen: I'm getting a paging alert from alerts-bot: db-migration-error on prod-canary. Paging myself.
oncall-jen: @dba-sam @eng-kai can you join? :rotating_light:
dba-sam: looking
eng-kai: on my way
pm-lina: tagged as P1 customer impact potential
oncall-jen: logs show migration failed with constraint error. attaching logs:
```sql
ERROR: column "user_metadata" does not exist
DETAIL:  Key (user_metadata)=() is not present in table "profiles"
CONTEXT: migrating batch 34/120
``` 
eng-kai: hmm schema mismatch — migration assumed new column exists in dependent service. Possibly ordering bug in release.
dba-sam: confirm: the migration script includes an UPDATE referencing profiles.user_metadata. Our current live schema for canary still version v11.
infra-ops: can we stop other canary migrations? rollback? 
oncall-jen: Initiating feature-flag kill for release/2026-03-15 to stop traffic to new code. @infra-ops please cut kill-switch.
infra-ops: done. Feature flag `use_new_profile_schema` set to off for canary and prod. :white_check_mark:
pm-lina: notifying impacted customers via status page: possible read errors on profile lookups in canary.
qa-amy: I see 502s in canary app logs correlated with migration errors.
eng-kai: quick mitigation: revert DB migration job on canary hosts (stop and rollback transaction) — but migrations already partially applied? dba-sam what's safe?
dba-sam: partial apply: some non-destructive DDL ran (added indexes), but the failing UPDATE didn't complete. We need to restore schema to v11 state. Options:
- run compensating SQL to re-add column temporarily
- rollback the DB snapshot for canary
- mark canary instances read-only
oncall-jen: what's fastest to restore customer traffic? prioritize read path.
dba-sam: fastest is to add a nullable column back to profiles to satisfy the UPDATE, then re-run migration idempotent. SQL:
```sql
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN user_metadata JSONB;
-- then run the UPDATE step to complete migration
``` 
eng-kai: risks? If service relies on new shape, adding back nullable column should be safe for short window.
pm-lina: approve. go ahead, coordinate with infra ops.
infra-ops: prepping runbook. taking DB snapshot now before any changes. ETA 2m.
dba-sam: snapshot complete. executing ALTER now.
```sql
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_metadata JSONB;
COMMIT;
``` 
dba-sam: ALTER complete. re-running migration step 34.
deploy-bot: Migration step 34 resumed on db-primary-canary: status=success
eng-kai: double-checking app responses... profiles requests are back to 200s in canary.
qa-amy: confirming no regressions in canary nightlies.
oncall-jen: status: kill-switch active, canary DB patch applied, migration resumed and completed on canary, traffic stable. escalating to a cautious prod rollout hold.
pm-lina: opening incident page: incident/2320001234
pm-lina: draft status update: "We detected a schema mismatch during canary DB migration causing profile lookup errors. We rolled back traffic via a feature-flag kill-switch and applied a temporary nullable column to complete migration in canary. No customer data loss detected. Investigating release ordering and will follow up with timeline for safe prod rollout."
eng-kai: next steps: root cause analysis — ordering of deploy vs migration jobs in our CI pipeline. Add migration pre-check to alert on schema drift.
dba-sam: will add a preflight check: verify presence/absence of columns referenced by migration steps.
infra-ops: coordinating hangover: we should schedule prod patch window after verifying changes in dedicated staging.
oncall-jen: oncall handoff to dba-sam in 30m. @dba-sam you'll own followups.
pm-lina: tagging support to prepare customer comms if needed.
support-bot: Created internal ticket S-8143 for customers that reported issues in canary
eng-kai: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft.
pm-lina: great. closing thread after handoff.
